verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage markets in-product AI agents for customer screening/ongoing monitoring and for transaction monitoring. These agents auto-remediate level-1 alerts and escalate high-risk cases, and users can review or override agent decisions. That amounts to AI-generated judgments on the user's own data inside the product, but the evidence is short marketing snippets with no description of explanatory insights or suggestions surfaced to the user. Missing for 10: documentation of AI-generated insights/explanations or recommendations shown in the UI, detail on how agent output is presented to reviewers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
